intendedAudience: Site owners who need to compare an official Google Search status observation with separately recorded evidence from their own site.
decision: Decide what to inspect next without treating official Google Search Status, controlled historical context, or own-site evidence as a current incident report or a causal explanation.

metadata.title: How do I compare Google Search status with my site evidence?
metadata.description: A source-bound worksheet for separating a decision-time Google Search Status observation, controlled historical context, and dated evidence from your own site.

sourceBindings.purpose: Use only for a decision-time official-status observation.
Use only as admitted official Google Search Central historical context.

worksheet.instruction: At the decision time, inspect the official Google Search Status source and record what you observed with its time; this worksheet does not report a current status or incident.
Keep any admitted Google Search Central material as controlled historical context only, separate from the decision-time observation and not as current incident evidence.
Record dated evidence from your own site separately, including what changed, what you observed, and what remains unverified.
Keep the conclusion unknown unless independently reviewed evidence establishes a connection; the comparison alone does not explain your own site.

factualStatements.text: The official Google Search Status source is admitted only for a direct decision-time observation, not for this worksheet to report a current incident.
The admitted Google Search Central material is used only as controlled historical context and not as current incident evidence.

boundaries.currentOfficialStatus: Inspect the official source directly at decision time; this contract does not report a current status or incident.
boundaries.historicalControlledExamples: Use controlled historical context only; it is not current incident evidence.
boundaries.ownSiteEvidence: Record your own site evidence separately; a comparison does not establish a connection.
boundaries.noCausation: This worksheet does not explain a change on your own site or establish its cause.
unknowns: Whether an official-status observation and an own-site change are connected remains unknown without independently reviewed evidence.
This contract does not determine a current incident, diagnosis, ranking effect, or remediation.
boundaries.privacyAndMeasurement: This worksheet does not collect, transmit, or retain visitor or site evidence and does not measure demand, traffic, conversion, revenue, or another commercial outcome.

faqs.question: Does this worksheet say Google Search is currently down?
faqs.answer: No. Inspect the official Google Search Status source directly at decision time; this contract does not report a current status or incident.

faqs.question: Can historical Google Search Central material prove the cause of my site issue?
faqs.answer: No. It remains controlled historical context and does not establish a connection to your own site evidence.

correctionAndCurrentnessPolicy: Recheck the official source directly at decision time and make a correction to any worksheet transcription against that source; controlled historical context remains separate and is never promoted to current incident evidence.

publication.coordinatorDependency: A coordinator-owned shared static route adapter must publish this content contract before it is publicly reachable.
